name: Critical Effects (DH2): Rending - Arm
description: Dark Heresy 2nd Edition, Table 7-19 (p. 240). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: The target drops anything held in that hand.
1 level of Fatigue. The target drops anything held in that hand.
The target drops anything held in that hand. Challenging (+0) Toughness test or suffer Blood Loss.
2 levels of Fatigue and knocked Prone. The arm is Useless for [[1d10]] rounds.
Blood Loss. The target drops anything held in that hand. The arm is Useless until medical attention.
[[1d5]] fingers severed; on a 5 the thumb goes too. Stunned for 1 round. Immediate Challenging (+0) Toughness test or gain the Lost Hand condition.
Blood Loss and [[1d10]] Strength damage. The arm is Useless until medical attention.
Immediate Challenging (+0) Toughness test or die from shock. On a success: Stunned for [[1d10]] rounds and Blood Loss. Gains the Lost Arm condition.
As result 9. If he carried a ranged weapon, roll [[1d100]]: on 96 or higher the severed hand fires it, striking one random target within [[2d10]] metres at a random hit location.
